title: 2 Kings
author: The author is not named; the book continues the prophetic history of Israel and Judah.
date: From Elijah's final ministry through the fall of Israel and Judah.
audience: Israel and Judah, showing the consequences of covenant unfaithfulness and the certainty of God's word.
historicalSetting: Second Kings records the ministries of Elijah and Elisha, the decline of both kingdoms, the fall of Samaria, reforms in Judah, and the exile to Babylon.
themes: Mercy in the midst of decline
The need for a righteous king
keyVerse: 2 Kings 17:13 — "Yahweh testified to Israel and to Judah by every prophet and every seer."
christFocus: The collapse of earthly kingship reveals the need for Christ, the faithful King who bears judgment, restores His people, and reigns forever.
outline: Decline and fall of Israel — 2 Kings 14-17
Judah's final kings and reforms — 2 Kings 18-23
Fall of Jerusalem and exile — 2 Kings 24-25
